g.text: A larger fee base can increase paybefore profits are realised
Annual management fee revenue, USD m
Fee revenue remains linked to the fee base.
Uniform annual fee base; before offsets and costs; not actual receipts.

Source: Case p. 1 (fund size and offered fee rate); Metrick & Yasuda (2007). $19.8bn × 1.50% = $297.00m; × 1.35% = $267.30m; × 90% × 1.35% = $240.57m.The third bar is a hypothesis, not a statement that all LPs reduced; the model does not say whether GP capital is charged the same way.
